items.quote: Senior Software Test Automation Engineer (AI-Driven)

brief.field: Location of the role(any travel required?)

items.quote: You must be physically located in Brazil
You'll take ownership of the test automation strategy
Design and implement scalable automation frameworks for modern web and desktop applications
Create and maintain automated tests across unit, integration, API, and end-to-end layers
Build reliable, reusable test suites for interactive 3D browser applications
Transform product requirements into comprehensive automated test scenarios
Develop and optimise CI/CD pipelines to ensure fast and reliable releases
Use AI-assisted development tools to improve test coverage, productivity, and defect detection
Create performance and load testing solutions to measure application scalability
Investigate test failures, eliminate flaky tests, and continuously improve automation stability
Contribute to monitoring and quality metrics by building dashboards and actionable reporting
8+ years' experience in Software Test Engineering, SDET, or Test Automation
Expert knowledge of Playwright and TypeScript
Strong experience testing modern React applications
Solid understanding of testing strategies across unit, integration, API, and end-to-end testing
Experience designing automation frameworks rather than simply maintaining existing ones
Hands-on experience using AI-powered development tools such as Cursor, Claude, GitHub Copilot, or similar
Strong understanding of web technologies, REST APIs, browser behaviour, and debugging tools
Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines
Excellent JavaScript/TypeScript skills
Good spoken English is required
Experience testing applications built with Three.js, WebGL, or other 3D rendering technologies
Knowledge of performance, stress, or load testing
Experience writing automation in Rust or C#
Exposure to CAD or engineering software such as Revit or Rhino
Experience testing .NET desktop applications, plugins, or native software
Previous experience helping scale QA practices across multiple products or engineering teams
CVs must be submitted in English

dimensions.name: Structure
dimensions.question: Is there a test strategy and framework to build on, or does this person start from a blank page?

dimensions.name: Risk / Experimentation
dimensions.question: How much room is there to try new tools, AI-based testing included, before they are proven?

evidence.quote: You'll take ownership of the test automation strategy

dimensions.name: Ambiguity
dimensions.question: How settled are the products under test: stable releases, or features still changing week to week?

evidence.quote: Work closely with software engineers, technical leads, and QA specialists
evidence.reading: Works closely with engineers and leads

dimensions.name: Product Thinking
dimensions.question: Should they help shape acceptance criteria with product, or turn finished requirements into tests?

dimensions.name: Execution Style
dimensions.question: What is the release rhythm today, and is the aim to make it faster or more predictable?

dimensions.name: Domain Orientation
dimensions.question: How well does this engineer need to understand how your users work in tools like Revit or Rhino to test the right things?

dimensions.name: Challenge / Conflict
dimensions.question: When quality and a release date pull apart, how much say should this person have in holding a release?

evidence.quote: Use AI-assisted development tools to improve test coverage, productivity, and defect detection
evidence.reading: AI tools part of the daily testing work

dimensions.name: Learning / Adaptability
dimensions.question: Which parts of the stack are new to most QA hires, such as the desktop or plugin side, and how much ramp-up time is there?

contradictions.note: Desktop applications are part of the scope, while desktop testing experience is a nice-to-have. Worth confirming how much of the work is on the desktop side.
quotes: Design and implement scalable automation frameworks for modern web and desktop applications
Experience testing .NET desktop applications, plugins, or native software

contradictions.note: Test suites for 3D browser applications are part of the job, while experience testing 3D rendering is a nice-to-have. Worth confirming how much of the testing is on the 3D side.
